conversations_private_owner.name: conversations_private_owner

document_chunks_section_length.name: document_chunks_section_length
document_chunks_section_length.value: "document_chunks"."section" is null or char_length("document_chunks"."section") between 1 and 500

documents_failure_reason.name: documents_failure_reason
documents_failure_reason.value:
(
        "documents"."ingestion_status" = 'failed'
        and "documents"."failure_reason" in (
          'too_large_for_sync_ingestion',
          'embedding_not_configured',
          'embedding_failed',
          'ingestion_failed'
        )
      ) or (
        "documents"."ingestion_status" <> 'failed' and "documents"."failure_reason" is null
      )

messages_user_has_no_audit_fields.name: messages_user_has_no_audit_fields
messages_user_has_no_audit_fields.value:
"messages"."role" <> 'user' or (
        "messages"."outcome" is null
        and "messages"."citation_validation" is null
        and "messages"."model_id" is null
        and "messages"."answer_reason" is null
        and "messages"."workflow_intent" is null
        and "messages"."escalation_reason" is null
        and "messages"."citations" = '[]'::jsonb
      )

messages_assistant_audit_fields.name: messages_assistant_audit_fields

support_submissions_complete_links.name: support_submissions_complete_links
support_submissions_complete_links.value:
(
        "support_submissions"."status" = 'pending'
        and "support_submissions"."conversation_id" is null
        and "support_submissions"."user_message_id" is null
        and "support_submissions"."assistant_message_id" is null
      ) or (
        "support_submissions"."status" = 'complete'
        and "support_submissions"."conversation_id" is not null
        and "support_submissions"."user_message_id" is not null
        and "support_submissions"."assistant_message_id" is not null
        and "support_submissions"."user_message_id" <> "support_submissions"."assistant_message_id"
      )

users_auth_identity_pair.name: users_auth_identity_pair

users_auth_subject_shape.name: users_auth_subject_shape
users_auth_subject_shape.value:
"users"."auth_subject" is null or (
        char_length("users"."auth_subject") between 1 and 255
        and "users"."auth_subject" !~ '[[:space:]]'
      )
